_readme: S447 SkyBrittlebush, 2026-10-22. The sitemap read (run 39770285975) shows both catalogs list the missing programs' own pages. Two causes are suspected. (1) NOT_PROGRAM_PATH's '/administration' drops every /administration-justice/ address at both colleges. (2) At Mt. San Jacinto the capture keeps no hidden tab panel ('tabs': 0 on nearly every near miss) while each page has a Requirements tab: SUBJECT_TOKEN reads 'ANTH 101' but not 'ANTH-101', and the catalog prints its codes with a hyphen (sources: BADM-103, ECON-C2001H). Read four pages as the capture does, to see the tab panels it leaves out and how their codes are printed. Santa Barbara City's Philosophy AA-T and Film, Television, and Electronic Media AS-T pages are read the same way, since they too were never candidates. Four loads, no model call.
